summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $1.32 million tranche of senior unsecured autocallable contingent coupon barrier notes due October 4, 2029, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000 and S&P 500 indices. Notes price at $1,000 each with a $27.50 quarterly contingent coupon and quarterly call observation beginning March 2027. This is a routine Series A medium-term note shelf takedown, not a special situation. Credit risk and index downside to the threshold govern payoff; no deal terms apply.
